_comment: UIDAI certificates pinned for Aadhaar verification. Downloaded 2026-10-16 from the URLs below (linked from https://uidai.gov.in/en/data-and-download). sha256 is over the DER encoding. services/aadhaar/certs.py refuses any file whose fingerprint differs. See docs/AADHAAR.md before adding or removing one.
